subject: Clearsky onboarding: invoice batching, PO requirements & net-tier alignment
messages:
From: Jordan Miles <j.miles@clearsky.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@clearsky.io
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor onboarding & payment terms — Clearsky Analytics

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Clearsky is excited to move forward. Finance asked that I kick off vendor onboarding so we can get POs flowing. A couple of items for alignment before we submit the onboarding packet:

- Clearsky standard billing is Net 60. For our first three months we can accept Net 45 if that helps accelerate activation.
- We are open to an early-pay discount (1% if paid within 10 days) — we've included a short request doc.
- We typically batch invoices weekly and include a PO reference on each invoice. Can you confirm Redwood's required PO format and whether invoice batching (one consolidated weekly invoice) is supported?

Attached: Clearsky_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, W-9_Clearsky.pdf, early_pay_request.pdf

Next steps: please advise who should complete the Redwood vendor portal invite and what PO number schema you need.

Thanks,
Jordan Miles
Head of Finance Ops
Clearsky Analytics

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>

Ask: 1) Can Finance accept Net 45 for onboarding? 2) Would Procurement prefer a VENDOR_PORTAL invite or standard email PO flow? 3) Are we OK with the early-pay discount they propose (1%/10d)?

I'll loop in the vendor in replies once we align.

Thanks,

Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2027 11:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Vendor onboarding & payment terms — Clearsky Analytics

Dylan / team —

Finance perspective: we can approve Net 45 for the initial 90-day onboarding period to help Clearsky get ramped. Long-term we prefer Net 30 or Net 45 depending on tiering, but Net 60 is out of our standard terms unless there's a negotiated contract reason.

On the early-pay discount: a 1%/10d is reasonable, but we need to route this through AP controls. Operationally we prefer the following:
- Invoices must reference a Redwood PO (format: RDW-<YYYYMM>-<PO#>).
- We support weekly invoice batching (single consolidated invoice per vendor per week) provided each invoice line references the underlying PO line items.
- To enable early-pay programing, AP needs: completed W-9, bank ACH details (or vouchered Payee form), and vendor portal enrollment.

Please ask Jordan to upload W-9 (they already provided it) and complete the vendor portal invite. Once vendor portal is active, AP will enable the early-pay flag and we can test 1%/10d on a single invoice run.

I'll attach the Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx for reference — procurement will fill the PO number once the account is active.

Marissa Cole
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Miles <j.miles@clearsky.io>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, accounts-payable@clearsky.io
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2027 14:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Vendor portal invite & PO routing (Clearsky Analytics)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks for sending the packet. I've created the vendor portal invite for Clearsky: https://vendor.redwood.ai/invite/XYZ-7782 (Expires in 7 days). Please accept and complete the onboarding form inside the portal — that will capture bank details and authorized signatory info we need for ACH and supplier validation.

A few procurement notes:
- Redwood requires a PO number on every invoice. Our PO format is RDW-<YYYYMM>-<PO#>. We'll generate the first PO once the portal submission is complete.
- We support weekly invoice batching (one consolidated invoice per calendar week). Please include separate line items per project/PO on that consolidated invoice.
- For early-pay enrollment, we'll enable a temporary early-pay flag on the account after the vendor completes ACH verification. The early-pay discount will be applied manually for the first cycle for auditing, then automated if it passes.

I'll also attach the PO template (Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx) to the portal and copy an AP contact into the vendor record. If you need a different remit address (or have multiple subsidiaries), flag that in the portal.

Best,
Monica Patel
Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference

[Attachment: Redwood_PO_Template.xlsx]

From: Jordan Miles <j.miles@clearsky.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@clearsky.io
Date: Fri, 05 Nov 2027 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal invite & PO routing (Clearsky Analytics)

Thanks Monica — invite accepted and onboarding form completed in the portal. I've uploaded the W-9 and bank ACH sheet there as requested and attached the same docs to this thread for reference. We agree to Net 45 for the first 90 days and accept the 1%/10d early-pay trial.

Action items from our side:
- Clearsky will accept the first PO when you generate RDW-202711-001 and will submit weekly consolidated invoices thereafter.
- We'll tag invoices with the PO number and project line items.
- Please confirm when the early-pay flag is active so AP can test the discount on the next Wednesday run.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to getting this live.

Jordan Miles
Head of Finance Ops
Clearsky Analytics

Attachments: Clearsky_onboarding_form_filled.pdf, W-9_Clearsky.pdf
